items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A revue program with chorus girls and dancers, the De Marcos as dancers? Yes, and Benny Fields and Blossom singing. I was in a show called “Star Time.”

ctx.x: I think that was before then.
